lines.en: : Well hooray for me getting to be second place! It is truly an honor to be graced by your presence.
: Just make sure you don’t start crying or something because it would be really exhausting having to navigate that twice within such a short period of time.
: Oh, don’t you worry about that. I’ll bottle my feelings up and cry when I’m alone, like any other civilized human being would do.
Once again, I find myself being dragged away from the party by a girl with a visible ribcage.

Granted, I haven’t seen Io without a shirt on to confirm this yet, but I have a hard time believing that she, like many other girls I commonly associate with, couldn't benefit from eating slightly more.
I suppose that’s a conversation for another day, though.
Because Io and I being alone together means things will go one of two ways.
She’ll either self-deprecate and say a bunch of depressing stuff while still managing to keep a smile glued to her face-
Or she will, once again, invite me to an amusement park.
The truth remains to be seen.
The secret third option, and one of the rarest for Io, is that she’ll elect to remain completely silent and gaze off toward the sky, likely thinking about how much she hates girls or something.
I don’t recall the forecast being cloudy with a chance of misery tonight, but I suppose no weather pattern can be discernible 100%% of the time.
Besides, the silence provides a nice break from the music inside- even if it’s at a noticeably lower volume than it had been the previous year.
It’s good to know that some of the girls are looking out for some of the others.
It’s worse knowing that some of them aren’t looking out for anyone at all.
: How do you feel about Halloween, Sensei?
: Is this a trick question? Because based on what you said just a few minutes ago, I feel like I might not be allowed to like it.
: I’m genuinely curious.
: I’m already set in my ways, but I’ll understand if you think there’s a little more to it than just slutty costumes and sugary treats.
: Or, alternatively, those may be the exact reasons you like it, and there won’t be anything more to it in your eyes either.
: I think...Halloween is the ideal time for me to be the lecherous, cynical observer I was born to be.
: So it’s the costumes and not the sugar that does it for you. Got it.
: I don’t think that should come as much of a surprise.
: It doesn’t. I mean, I’ve more or less figured out what you place at the top of your priority list by now.
: And you still invite me outside to be alone? Brave move.
: You don’t have to like everything about a person if you’re going to...you know, like them.
: Sometimes you just get desperate and settle for less than the complete package because you realize the bundle you’re looking for just...doesn’t exist.
: Or maybe it’s discontinued or something. I don’t know.
: But it’s not like I’m going to like you any less for fantasizing about girls in slutty outfits.
: For a lot of people, that’s the only way they can find value.
: They give up on themselves and put their body on display like some sort of perverted art exhibit and wait patiently as all sorts of people approach them and make their offers.
: Which, then, allows us to separate them into two more categories.
: Those willing to accept offers...and those too scared to do so.
: Or, I guess there’s a third category as well in the fact that some people are just seeking the sort of validation you can only get from knowing you got someone to orgasm.
: But those people are the worst of the three, and even knowing they exist is enough for me to write off their presence on this stupid, boring planet.
So, it appears that it’s going to be another night of depressing observations (Light on the self-loathing) after all.
That’s fine, though.
This is her default state.
And if the pattern is going to break, there needs to be something or someone who personally breaks it.
Io is far too tired of moving to ever break anything on her own.
: I don’t have a wordy response for you or anything, but I’m glad that the type of person I am hasn’t been enough to push you away yet.
: So am I.
: Sure, I know that a lot of it might just be me intentionally fusing into you the way an anglerfish would while mating.
: Do you know about that? How the males are just parasites who just feed off the females’ nutrients after fusing with them and turn into little, fishy sperm factories?
: Correct me if I’m wrong here, but are you calling yourself a...fish sperm factory right now?
: Heheh...
: Even that might be a little generous.
: At least the female in the anglerfish scenario has something to gain from the presence of a parasitic male.
: What do you gain from me?
: And, if I attach myself to you, much like I already have...how will your life become better?
: I have nothing of value for you, Sensei. I have nothing to give.
: You don’t have to give me anything.
: We’re not fish. And I certainly don’t intend to reproduce with you.
: Well...that’s a relief, at least.
: Thanks for following me out here, by the way.
: I thought that after not really making an effort to hang out with me at the beach, you’d already gotten bored or something.
: But I realize now that it was probably just me overanalyzing things and thinking I was higher up on your list of people to spend time with than I actually am.
: That weekend felt like it just kind of flew by anyway. We’ll hang out more soon.
: Amusement park? I’m contractually obligated to ask at this point.
: I don’t remember ever signing this contract.
: That’s cause there was never a signature involved.
: You “signed” it when you held my hand underneath the stars just blocks away from where I waste away my youth.
: Blocks away from where you walked into my life.
: First, with a random blonde. Then, with my best friend.
: But now...you come there for me.
: And once an anglerfish fuses with its partner, it stays there for life.
: Even when you get tired of me feeding off of your energy because I’m too weak to find any on my own...even then, I won’t leave you.
: So do whatever you want with me in complete disregard for what I want myself and-
: Wait, why do you look so exhausted all of a sudden? Am I talking too much again?
: I’m just trying to figure out what the rationale behind tonight's suspiciously composed breakdown is.
: Umm...a cry for attention because I waited all night in your room at the beach for the chance to see you only to go home empty handed?
: A desperate plea for a reason to wake up tomorrow disguised in the form of an education lecture of deep sea fish?
: You can spin this any number of ways, but it really won’t wind up detracting from how strange it is on a sheer conceptual basis- no matter which way you go with.
: Also, I’m terrified that you’ll stop being attracted to me if I don’t do anything to put myself out there the way that gyaru or the annoying green-eyed soccer player do.
: There wasn’t really a reason for me to drop that part in there, but I’m on a roll tonight, so yeah. Just gonna get that out of the way.
: The costumes aren’t what make me attracted to people, Io. I’ve already told you I’m attracted to you before.
: I know. But the average train of events in the case of you being attracted to me would lead to you wanting to take things further.
: And without me ever making an effort to actually do that, the attraction you have toward me might begin to fade.
: We already know I serve no purpose in simply being around you. So if your attraction, or the last beacon of hope in the soon-to-be warzone that is our relationship, goes away...what’s left?
: I wouldn’t say you haven’t made an effort.
: I would.
: Liking someone is confusing for someone like me.
: There are all of these things that someone like you would call childish floating around inside of my head, like...wanting to hold hands. Or wanting to rest my head on your shoulder.
: But...
: Anything more than that is just...
: Hm? The fuck you two doing out here?
The conversation screeches to a halt as Yumi, once again, shows up to the Halloween party fashionably late.
And, just like with Io here, her anti-costume policy reigns supreme in keeping me at the same level of lewd fantasization I always am regarding her.
: This guy harassin’ you?
: Yumi, come on.
: Ain’t talkin’ to you, dick. Talkin’ to...whatshername.
: Io Ichimonji.
: Right, yeah. Weren’t we supposed to fight for the dorm war or whatever the fuck that was?
: The contest was just about avoiding being in the contest.
: Oh, right. Yeah. That shit sucked.
: Yumi, would you mind letting the two of us-
: Actually! Uh...I should probably go eat something.
: I took some anxiety meds before I came here and I’m not really supposed to be doing that on an empty stomach.
: Anyway, sorry for being really confusing and probably making you like me less. Please forget anything I said that may have pushed you in that direction and...remember that I...
: Nevermind.
: See you.
: The fuck?
: How the hell’d you manage to scare away a girl that’s not me? Thought that shit just...never even happened to you.
: I think you’re the one who scared her away. Everything was fine until you showed up.
: Well, maybe “fine” is the wrong word. But it was certainly better than it is with her just...not being here, I guess?
: Well, gee. Sorry for showing up and preventing you from adding one more notch in your fuckin’ belt.
: Shit’s gonna get so heavy soon enough that you’ll need a second belt to even hold that one up.
: That aside, Chika was looking for you earlier. She said you wouldn’t text her back or something.
: Yeah. About that.
: Chinami wanted to fill up the pool again and the fuckin’ twerp dropped my phone into the water.
: I knew that girl was secretly evil.

: It wasn’t a big deal or whatever since I’ve heard that you can just put it in rice to fix it as long as you do it quick, but then I had to wait for the rice to cook and it was a whole fuckin’ thing.
: You-
: You’re not...supposed to cook the rice, Yumi...
: What? You bein’ serious right now?
: You’re supposed to use uncooked rice so it can absorb the water...
: You really didn’t know that?
: Wha...How the fuck was I supposed to know that when I didn’t have a phone to look it up?!
: Oh my god...
: What?! I can’t be the first person to make that mistake!
: I’m going to have to buy you a new phone now, aren’t I?
: You don’t have to do shit. I’m not your fucking...girlfriend that you need to buy presents for or whatever. I’m my own person and I’ll figure it out.
: Oh, right. That reminds me.
: I have something for you.
: What?
: You...do?
: Yeah. Hold on.
I reach into my blazer and pull out the package that Yuki handed me earlier.
I still have no idea what’s inside of it, but it was light enough for me to forget about it until being reminded, so it’s probably just a shirt or scarf or something like that.
: What the?...
: Hm? It’s your birthday, isn’t it?
: There aren’t many days of the year that it’s normal to get presents, but I’d imagine that today is one of them where you should make an exception.
: But...
: You and me...we’re...
: Oh, sorry. This isn’t from me. I didn’t get you anything.
: Huh?
Yumi snatches the present from me as I take a step back to give her room to open it.
I probably should have prefaced this exchange by saying from the start that the gift was from her mother, but it’s out of my hands now.
Like, literally. I am no longer holding onto the present.
: Remember how I told you your mom was working at a bar now?
: Well, she managed to scrounge up enough to get you this, I guess.
: I saw her earlier when I went to pick up decorations with Sana and she asked me to give it to you.
: I have no idea what’s inside, but-
: Just go.
: Yumi, if you want me to get you something-
: I don’t! Now get the fuck away from me!
: Now!
: Okay.
I turn around to head back to the party, leaving Yumi on her own.
The same way she always is.
: *Sniff*
*Plop*
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
